notes: Eight interaction episodes are visible. The two leaves of each double-door closet are reported separately, and the utensil drawer is reported as two episodes because it appears closed around frame 1104 and open again by frame 1112. No machine doors, refrigerator drawers, or other cabinets show a supported state-changing manipulation.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user opens and later closes two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer twice.
